description: Armed trainer displayed at a road junction inside Base Aérienne 210, the Burkinabè air force's SF.260 home station at Bobo-Dioulasso. Construction number 343/29-037. Recorded as preserved from a first-hand visit dated 21 May 2025; a small aircraft-shaped object sits at the junction on Esri 0.34 m imagery acquired 28 October 2025. Variant unresolved: the source's construction-number-backed entry says WL while GlobalSecurity describes Burkina Faso's armed SF.260s as WP - four of which came direct from Italy and were stationed at Bobo-Dioulasso.
